scene_analysis.scene_overview: A view of a store front with a glass door and window, showing a sidewalk and buildings across the street. The store has a white bag hanging on the door handle and a sign on the window that says 'claimo' in blue letters. There are books on display in the window and shelves inside the store. The sidewalk outside is made of small square tiles and there are trees and other buildings across the street. The sky is blue and clear.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building across the street is tall and has a flat roof. It is made of concrete and has a large window on the top floor. The building next to it is shorter and has a sloping roof. It is also made of concrete but has a more ornate design. The building behind it is taller and has a pointed roof. It is made of brick and has a large window on the top floor.
scene_analysis.materials: The store's exterior is made of glass and metal. The door and window frames are dark brown. The bags hanging on the door are white with blue writing. The sidewalk is made of small square tiles. The trees and other buildings across the street have green leaves and windows.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables outside the store. There are also some trash cans and recycling bins.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes along the sidewalk. They are well-maintained and provide shade.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the sidewalk and on the buildings across the street. They are mostly illegible.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is made of concrete and has a smooth finish.
scene_analysis.spatial_enclosure: The sidewalk is relatively narrow and winding. It is lined with trees and other buildings.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are a few people walking down the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is bright and even.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area is quiet and peaceful.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The area is a great place to attend a holiday gathering.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is busy and lively.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is bustling with students and tourists.
